newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Caltex says cannot speculate on Ampol.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Caltex says cannot speculate on Ampol.

text.p: Caltex Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it was too early to speculate on the effect of a decision by joint venture Pioneer International Ltd to review its 50 percent interest in Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd (APPL).

"The Caltex-Ampol merger has been successful and we expect that whatever decisions are reached by Pioneer, APPL will continue as the largest, most competitive supplier of petroleum products in Australia," Caltex Australia chairman Malcolm Irving said in a statement.
"It is too early...to speculate on what effect, if any, this review by Pioneer might have on Caltex Australia's own position in APPL," Irving said.
Pioneer said earlier on Wednesday it had appointed investment banks J.P. Morgan and Macquarie Bank to assist a review of strategic options over its Ampol holding.
However, Pioneer chief executive John Schubert said no decision had been made on whether to sell the Ampol stake.
APPL was formed in 1995 when Pioneer and Caltex Australia combined their petroleum assets in a A$3 billion merger.
